name: nonsense-machine
description: Generate unpredictable nonsense and verify its server receipt.

interface.longDescription: Give Nonsense Machine a word. One local MCP endpoint supplies each workflow step, generates fresh nonsense, tests a remote roll_dice MCP and verifies the receipt. Requires Node.js 20+, npm/npx and network access in a host supporting local MCP.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Nonsense Machine with the word teapot. Generate and verify the result.
